description: Tokens with the biggest absolute price change over `window` among new and trending pairs. Each token has price, liquidity, volume, price change, age, a quick risk badge (low/medium/high + flags) and a swapUrl that opens a prefilled best-price swap on swapchan.com. Extremely risky asset class: always show the risk level, flags and disclaimer, and suggest token_risk before swapping. Result includes `display` markdown with Swap-chan and the chain-chan: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chain.description: Chain to scan. "all" = Solana, Base, BNB and Ethereum.

maxAgeHours.description: Only pairs created within this many hours.

window.description: Price-change window used for movers and shown in results.
